sql: WITH actor AS (SELECT "ActorJson"::jsonb->>'subjectId' AS owner FROM connections."CatalogJobs" WHERE "ConnectionId"='1bf23f9d36bf4ceba09d745f04d8f743' LIMIT 1), expired AS (SELECT s.* FROM connections."ConnectionSecrets" s,actor WHERE s."Owner"=actor.owner AND s."OrganizationId"='org-demo' AND s."SiteIds"=ARRAY['site-a'] AND s."UsedAtUtc" IS NULL AND s."Purpose"='POSTGRESQL_READONLY' AND s."ExpiresAtUtc"<now() ORDER BY s."ExpiresAtUtc" LIMIT 1), revoked AS (SELECT s.*, c."SecretVersion" AS current_version FROM connections."ConnectionSecrets" s JOIN connections."Connections" c ON c."Id"=s."ConnectionId",actor WHERE s."Owner"=actor.owner AND s."Ciphertext"='' AND s."Tag"='' AND s."Nonce"='' AND s."UsedAtUtc" IS NOT NULL AND c."SecretId"<>s."Id" AND c."SecretVersion">s."Version" LIMIT 1) SELECT json_build_object('serverNow',now(),'expired',(SELECT json_build_object('id',"Id",'expiresAtUtc',"ExpiresAtUtc",'usedAtUtc',"UsedAtUtc",'purpose',"Purpose",'owner',"Owner") FROM expired),'revoked',(SELECT json_build_object('id',"Id",'version',"Version",'currentVersion',current_version,'usedAtUtc',"UsedAtUtc",'ciphertextCleared',"Ciphertext"='' AND "Tag"='' AND "Nonce"='') FROM revoked));
